{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsorfield generator posts''' were devices that to generate the cushions of air that [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila's]] [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrains]] traveled on. Using the posts, the trains could travel at speeds of up to 200 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
